message: MySkedul v1.4.07 is live! Check out the new QR Scanner, Multi-Schedule support, and Direct Group Imports.
changelog: QR Scanning: Share and scan schedule QR codes instantly.
Multi-Schedule: Save and switch between multiple schedules.
Direct Group Import: Fast import from Group tabs for ABESIT.
Feedback & Upvoting: Upvote ideas and send app feedback.
Overhauled Week View: Completely redesigned weekly planner view.
Bug Fixes: Restored local backup functionality and fixed minor issues.
